bio.text: Jimmy Patronis, a Republican, represents Florida's 1st Congressional District in the Western Panhandle, which he won in a special election after Matt Gaetz resigned.
A Panhandle native, he earned a political science degree from Florida State University.

He served eight years in the Florida House of Representatives, then on the Florida Public Service Commission, and in 2017 Governor Rick Scott appointed him Florida's Chief Financial Officer, a post he won statewide election to twice.
